The answer is Bhartrihari. There are some stories of him being a king and a relative of Vikramaditya, while scholars focus on his philosophical works and his shatakas. Here is the first poem of his that I ever heard because All India Radio Hyderabad used to play this before their weekly Sanskrit lesson. The poem means: “Bracelets, glittering necklaces, baths, lotions, flowers, hair decorations: none of these things truly adorn a person. Voice is the only thing that truly elevates a person, if used in a cultured manner. All other ornaments decay with time, but your words are your only lasting ornament.” https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z9xPy0ABuoI
